content.comment_body: Hello, I'm new to the [product_name] and having trouble setting up remote monitoring on my iPad. I can connect and manage the device wirelessly while at my office, but I can't get it to connect from my house. Any help would be appreciated!
Hi, make sure your internet connection at home is working properly.
I'm currently sending this message from my iPad using my home internet. Do you have any other suggestions?

Your office and home networks use different gateways. To access [product_name] remotely, you may need to set up a static IP for it on your home router and configure port forwarding. For more details, refer to the information at [url].

I experienced a similar issue with security cameras. You can connect when using the same local internet, but not from outside your network. Here's a simple guide: [url]. It’s quite cool once everything is set up.
Hello, please review the note found in this [document]. Hope that helps.

Thanks for all the advice. I'm still having trouble. Is anyone using the BT Home Hub 4? If so, could you walk me through the configuration? On the app for my iPad, I have these settings: Port 8080 and IP Address 192.168.1.80. Should I make any changes to the office router settings, considering it works immediately with my iPad at the office?

analysis.insight_summary: User is having trouble remotely accessing a [product_name] device from an iPad when outside the local network, with successful connections at the office but failures at home. The discussion reveals confusion over networking and remote access setup, suggesting that better documentation or support might be required for users attempting remote monitoring.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects remote connectivity between their iPad and the [product_name] device to be straightforward and reliable, without needing complex network adjustments for different locations.
